# Explore Memberships

[See Options](https://boulderingproject.com/pricing-membership/#location-tab-select)

## Together Impossible Becomes Approachable

### Belong

World-class climbing. Carefully curated yoga. Fitness with impact. Every member has a unique reason for being here and uses our spaces in their own way. Whether it’s hopping on a work call in the co-working space between sessions, joining fellow go-getters at the 6 am fitness class, or the calm following evening yoga, there’s always a place for you on the pads.

### Facilities

We’re never static. From a single location in Seattle, Bouldering Project built a presence in nine cities. Membership comes with access to all of our gyms. Every space is a little different, but all gyms include:

- Expansive climbing terrain
- Dedicated yoga studio with classes for all levels
- Complete fitness space with weight lifting and cardio equipment
- Co-working and social spaces, for plugging in and hanging out

## Membership Benefits

![](https://boulderingproject.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/1224-WEB-ICONS_WHITE_ACCESS-TO-ALL-LOCATIONS-80x80.png)

### Access to All our Locations

With your membership, you'll have access to 13 Bouldering Project locations across the US!

![](https://boulderingproject.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/1224-WEB-ICONS_WHITE_UNLIMITED-CLASSES-80x80.png)

### Unlimited Classes

Access to our full slate of yoga and fitness classes.

![](https://boulderingproject.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/1224-WEB-ICONS_WHITE_CLIMBING-PROGRESSION-CLASS-80x80.png)

### Climbing Progression Classes

Regular free climbing classes to help you progress on your climbing journey.

![](https://boulderingproject.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/1224-WEB-ICONS_WHITE_GUEST-PASS-80x80.png)

### Free Guest Passes

2 free guest passes a month to use for family and friends. Restrictions may apply.

![](https://boulderingproject.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/1224-WEB-ICONS_WHITE_20-PERC-DISCOUNT-80x80.png)

### 10% Discount on Retail

Your membership comes with a 10% discount on clothing, and gear in our retail store.

![](https://boulderingproject.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/1224-WEB-ICONS_WHITE_WORKSHOPS-PROGRAMS-EVENTS-80x80.png)

### Access to Workshops, Programs & Events

Exclusive access to special members-only workshops, programs, and events.

## Access Memberships: Bouldering is Better Together

Our Access Memberships came from a desire to live out our core value of Inclusivity. We wanted to ensure that qualifying low-income homes still have access to quality fitness programs within their community. If you believe you qualify for an Access Membership and want to learn more, apply today.

[Learn More about Access Memberships](https://boulderingproject.com/access-memberships/)

Access Memberships

## FAQs

Have additional questions? [Contact us](https://boulderingproject.com/contact/). We’re here to help!

### What is included in a Bouldering Project membership?

Every Bouldering Project membership includes unlimited access to all climbing, open fitness training areas, weight rooms, system boards, yoga classes, core fitness classes, and introductory climbing clinics. Members also receive 2 complimentary guest passes per month for friends and family, and discounts on retail gear.

### Can I use my Bouldering Project membership at other locations in different cities?

Yes. Your active Bouldering Project membership features full national reciprocity, granting you unlimited cross-access to all 13 Bouldering Project locations across the United States! You can check-in with your membership at any of our locations in Seattle, Austin, Brooklyn, Boston, D.C., Minneapolis, St. Paul, Salt Lake City, or Tempe.

### How do I cancel or freeze my Bouldering Project membership?

You can freeze or cancel your month-to-month recurring membership at any time with zero long-term contract commitments.

Memberships can be frozen for up to 3 months at a time for a flat monthly fee (fee varies depending on your home region, typically $8-$10), which allows you to reactivate later without paying a new activation fee.

Visit the [manage membership page](https://boulderingproject.com/manage-membership/) to make changes to your membership.

### What is the exact deadline to submit a cancellation or freeze request?

All membership status adjustments, freezes, and cancellation requests must be submitted online through the [manage membership page](https://boulderingproject.com/manage-membership/) by **11:59 PM on the 26th day of the month prior to your next billing cycle**. Requests submitted after the 26th will apply to the subsequent month’s invoice.
